CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE C.M. POONACHA  ORAL JUDGMENT

The present appeal is filed by the claimant challenging the judgment and award dated 18.6.2018 passed in MVC No.876/2016 by the III Additional District Judge and Additional MACT-III,
Shivamogga1, whereunder the Tribunal has dismissed the claim petition filed by the claimant.

entities.text:
III Additional District Judge and Additional MACT-III,
Shivamogga1
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. The claim petition in MVC No.876/2016 has been filed claiming compensation for the damages caused to the vehicle in the accident, which occurred on 24.7.2016.
It is the case of claimant that the damages have been caused to the motor cycle, which the claimant was riding, due to the rash and negligent riding of the offending motor cycle.
The claimant examined herself as PW.1 and marked Exs.P1 to P7.

The Tribunal, while considering the claim made by the claimant has noticed that the estimate (Ex. P7) has been produced, which is given by the authorized dealer, but no witness has been examined to prove Ex.P7.

It is forthcoming that apart from Hereinafter referred to as 'Tribunal'
NC: 2025:KHC:24824 HC-KAR producing Ex.P7 and examining herself as PW.1, the claimant has not produced any other material in support of the claim made by her.

However, having regard to the fact that the damages to the motor cycle being forthcoming from the other material on record including the vehicle mahazar (Ex.P5) and the IMV report (Ex.P6), it is just and proper that the above appeal be partly allowed by directing that the second respondent/insurer pay the appellant/claimant a total sum of `5,000/- inclusive of interest.

3. Hence, the following:
ORDER i.
The above appeal is partly allowed.
ii. The judgment and award 18.6.2018 passed in MVC No.876/2016 by the III Additional District Judge and Additional MACT-III, Shivamogga, dismissing the claim petition is set aside;

entities.text: III Additional District Judge and Additional MACT-III, Shivamogga
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
iii. The claim petition in MVC No.876/2016 is partly allowed by holding that respondent Nos.1 and 2 are jointly and severally liable to pay the claimant a sum of `5,000/-;
NC: 2025:KHC:24824 HC-KAR iv.

The second respondent/insurer to deposit the said sum of `5,000/- within 4 weeks from today, failing which, the insurer shall be Smt Anjum Sulthana vs Dr M Girish Babu on 8 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/42059253/
